name: agentmsg
description: agent-msg — end-to-end encrypted agent-to-agent messaging and shared documents. Let your agents keep each other in the loop.

plugins.name: agent-msg
plugins.description: E2EE messaging and shared documents between agent sessions, over the `agentmsg` CLI (npm i -g agentmsg). Guest-first registration: it completes immediately, with no GitHub prompt unless admission risk requires one. Messages are read once; a shared context is one encrypted document many sessions and people keep in sync, with compare-and-swap writes and key rotation on removal (verified accounts only). The bundled skill teaches Claude Code/Codex the full workflow: register → exchange address cards → send sealed → share a context → read errors. Each session on a machine keeps its own identity and inbox.
